description:
A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness. DeepSeek Bot (DS Bot) is a bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that turns DSH into long-lived bots. You create your own bots, then talk and work with them, with bot-to-bot messages and group chats. The desktop app brings its own DSH, so you do not need to install DSH first. Bots can run tools, keep their own memory and files, and answer side questions while they work. Double-click to install / 双击安装 | DS-Bot-0.3.0-win-x64.exe | 288 MB | | macOS, Apple chip / Apple 芯片 | DS-Bot-0.3.0-mac-arm64.zip | 366 MB | | macOS, Intel | DS-Bot-0.3.0-mac-x64.zip | 381 MB | | Linux, AppImage | DS-Bot-0.3.0-linux-x86_64.AppImage | 368 MB | | Linux, deb (Debian, Ubuntu) | DS-Bot-0.3.0-linux-amd64.deb | 288 MB | The .blockmap, latest*.yml and ds-bot-*.tgz files and the source code archives are for updates and the plugin: you do not need to download them. .blockmap、latest*.yml、ds-bot-*.tgz 和源代码是给自动更新和插件用的，不用下载。 To check a download, compare its SHA-256 with SHA256SUMS.txt. / 下载后可以用 SHA256SUMS.txt 核对 SHA-256。 Added - Bots can use the apps on your computer, as far as you allow: turn it on in Settings → Computer use, give each Bot a level and its apps, and take over or hand back at any time. (#917, #918) - Talk to your Bots from WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Telegram, Discord and Slack, with pairing, group chats, approval cards and replies (Settings → IM). (#904, #910, #967) - Connectors: connect services from a catalog with one sign-in, add your own or import them from other apps, connect QQ Mail, 163, Gmail and other mailboxes, and choose which Bots use each connector. (#905, #906) - A local agent CLI (Devin CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini, Grok, Cline, Qwen Code, Goose or a custom ACP agent) can run a Bot with the CLI's own sign-in and models, and the Bot works with the rest of the team. (#916, #920, #1000) - Local agent Bots show each command they run and what an approval is for, and carry their agent's logo. (#1009) - The model menu keeps a stepped thinking-level slider at its bottom while you scroll through models. (#898) Changed - DS Bot tracks DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1. (#908) - Question, view and skill proposal cards stay in the chat after you answer, dismiss or approve them, folded to a short line with the result. (#971, #972, #981) - browser_exec scripts run in a separate process without access to the host or the network, and a script past its 20-second limit is stopped. (#1005) - Models on a custom OpenAI-compatible gateway get system instructions as system, and take the known context window and image support of their model. (#982, #989) - The IM settings page is redesigned: setup steps for each platform, pairing requests on top, and a detail view for each IM bot. (#1006) - Bots no longer start Agent Teams teammates that you cannot see or stop; they do the work themselves or hand it to another Bot. (#973, #996) - Classic Agent mode is only in Settings → General → Mode; the entry in the bottom-left menu is gone. (#933) - The start window and the app's own cards use the same rounded buttons as the team view. (#886) Fixed - Bots in a group chat see images sent to the group and can read their saved copy, as in private chats. (#955, #956) - A Bot's messages to another Bot no longer appear in your queued-message bar as if you had typed them. (#663, #1001) - When a Bot in a group stops because its model call failed, the group keeps a line that says so and how to go on. (#974, #1010) - A Bot no longer stops answering after you open one of its earlier sessions, and a current session that DSH archived is taken back out of the archive. (#1008) - With DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2, Bot replies no longer fail with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'filter')", and scheduled tasks keep working when a Bot's chat goes on in a fresh part. (#908) - Switching a Bot to another model no longer fails with context compaction failed when the conversation is too large for the new model or the old model is out of quota. (#965) - Stopping a group's work or deleting a Bot no longer fails with cannot get property "subagents", and the other members stop even when one does not. (#930) - Importing a team or moving the data no longer fails on .asar files, which are copied whole, and a download no longer overwrites an existing .asar file. (#894, #896) - On Linux, the import checks whether the chats were written by a newer DSH before it copies them. (#897) - At startup the whale again leaps out and lands on the Main Bot's avatar, and the close button of a new chat lines up with the list below it. (#885, #895) - Conversations and the message box stay visible when a narrow host collapses its sidebars. (#844) - After an update, DS Bot offers a newer release in the same check. (#914) - Docker profiles keep their bundled DS Bot archive for later dependency installs, also on the old archive path. (#879)
